1. Executive Overview
Narrative text section - useful for text retrieval and grounded summarization
NovaCore Systems Ltd. develops industrial AI gateways, computer-vision appliances, and connected sensor hubs
for manufacturing, logistics, and energy companies. During FY2026, the company focused on three priorities:
expanding enterprise deployments in Europe, improving the gross margin of its flagship AtlasEdge product line,
and shortening post-deployment support response times.
FY2026 revenue reached USD 132.0 million, up from USD 97.5 million in FY2025. Europe became the
fastest-growing region, supported by automotive and warehouse automation projects. The AtlasEdge X1 remained
the highest-margin product, while VisionHub Pro generated the largest number of new enterprise pilots.
Management approved a further USD 11.5 million investment in the Penang assembly facility for test automation
and energy-efficiency upgrades.
The company ended the year with 1,480 employees. Engineering represented 38% of headcount, operations 27%,
sales and customer success 22%, and corporate functions 13%. Customer satisfaction improved as average
support resolution time declined steadily through August.

For FY2027, NovaCore is targeting revenue between USD 158 million and USD 166 million, with an operating
margin of 19-20%. Planned investments include the Penang facility expansion, a new European
solution-engineering hub, and a second-generation AtlasEdge platform designed for larger multimodal AI
workloads.
Management expects Europe to remain the largest regional revenue contributor, while Asia Pacific is expected to
remain the fastest market for new customer-logo growth. The board has asked management to preserve cash
discipline and avoid overbuilding manufacturing capacity ahead of confirmed enterprise demand.
Suggested multimodal RAG checks:
• Which product has the highest gross margin, and what does the product image say about it?
• Which region grew fastest, and which region had the highest CSAT?
• What was the support resolution time in August compared with January?
• According to the supply-chain diagram, where is the critical quality-control point?
• What percentage of the Penang facility electricity came from solar?
• Combine the financial table and quarterly graph: what was FY2026 revenue, and which quarter was the peak?
